 South Korean-Japanese boy band NEXZ set to bring their first Asia Tour to Kuala Lumpur in May 2027
 Wednesday, 18 Nov 2026
 | 6:50 PM MYT
 share 
 bookmark 
 K-pop boy group NEXZ, a combination of Japanese-Korean singers, will perform in Kuala Lumpur on May 29, 2027, as part of their first Asia tour. Produced by JYP Entertainment and promoted by Live Nation Malaysia, the concert will take place at Zepp KL.
 Known for intricate choreography, powerful performances and tightly synchronized formations, the seven-member group has earned a reputation as a dynamic live act.
 Following promotions for their latest release, “SAUCIN’,” the members are also bringing greater confidence and maturity to the stage, after performing at major Latin American festivals, including “STRAYCITY” and Rock in Rio.
 NEXZ launched the tour with two concerts at Seoul’s Olympic Hall on October 17 and 18, where enthusiastic fans, known as NEX2Y, welcomed them. The shows featured individual solo stages highlighting each member’s distinct style.
 The tour will include 12 shows across eight Asian regions. After dates in Hyogo, Aichi and Tokyo in January, and Hong Kong and Taipei in February, the group will perform in Singapore on April 24 before arriving in Kuala Lumpur.
 NEX2Y second-generation membership presale registration will be open through the FANS app from November 18 at 11am until November 20 at 11am. The membership presale takes place on December 1 from 12pm to 3pm.
 Mastercard cardholders can access a separate presale on December 1 from 5pm until 11.59pm. Live Nation members can purchase tickets during the presale on December 2, from 1pm to 11.59pm.
 Tickets for the general public go on sale December 3 at 1pm via GoLive Asia. Live Nation membership sign-up and presale information are available at livenation.my.
